elfprototype:CrackedSeal.NAME: Cracked Seal
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you #ySeal a card each turn, draw #b1 card.

elfprototype:WholeSeal.NAME: Whole Seal
elfprototype:WholeSeal.FLAVOR: The crack is mended with gold.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #yCracked #ySeal. The first #b2 times you #ySeal a card each turn, draw #b1 card.

elfprototype:DuskGauntlet.NAME: Dusk Gauntlet
elfprototype:DuskGauntlet.FLAVOR: Its veins glow on their own in the dark.
DESCRIPTIONS: After your first draw each combat, #yErode the leftmost card in your hand.

elfprototype:SilverleafBrooch.NAME: Silverleaf Brooch
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you #ySeal a card yourself each turn, gain #b4 #yBlock.

elfprototype:MirrorEarring.NAME: Mirror Earring
DESCRIPTIONS: The first cursed card you play each turn deals #b3 more damage per hit.

elfprototype:MossCharm.NAME: Moss Charm
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, if no cursed card is in your hand, gain #b4 #yBlock.

elfprototype:WorldtreeBlessing.NAME: Worldtree Blessing
elfprototype:WorldtreeBlessing.FLAVOR: You do not face the storm alone.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of combat, gain #b6 #yBlock. The first time you use a potion each combat, heal #b3 HP.

elfprototype:EclipseStone.NAME: Eclipse Stone
elfprototype:EclipseStone.FLAVOR: The moment light and dark overlap.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time #yChime reaches #b6 each turn, gain #b1 energy and draw #b1 card.

elfprototype:Whetstone_Elf.NAME: Whetstone
elfprototype:Whetstone_Elf.FLAVOR: The sharper the blade, the brighter the curse.
DESCRIPTIONS: Cursed attacks deal #b1 more damage per hit.

elfprototype:CursedCrown.NAME: Cursed Crown
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain #b1 energy at the start of each turn. After drawing each turn, #yErode the leftmost card in your hand.
